paras: Gyldenstolpe's worm skink (Isopachys gyldenstolpei), also known commonly as Gyldenstolpe's isopachys and Gyldenstolpe's snake skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Thailand.
The specific name, gyldenstolpei, is in honor of Swedish ornithologist Nils Gyldenstolpe.
I. gyldenstolpei is found only in Thailand.
The preferred natural habitat of I. gyldenstolpei is forest.
The maximum total length (including tail) of I. gyldenstolpei is 300 mm (12 in). The species is limbless.
I. gyldenstolpei is terrestrial and fossorial.
